description: What each brand is actually selling now, read from how fast its products collect reviews (the review widget's own count, deduplicated across colours that share one count): fastest_growing (reviews gained in the window, default 14 days, with the store's own bestseller rank, homepage link, price and stock), new_in_top_5 (products that entered the top 5 vs the window before), launches (first seen in the last 45 days: reviews since first seen and a read: collecting reviews / early / no reviews yet) and selling_but_rated_low (gaining reviews with an average of 3.5 or less). Review growth tracks the store's own bestseller sort on most stores but is not sales: use it as a demand signal. Brands whose review widget we do not read are not_measured. Window 7-90 days.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.
